booking.instructions: Call (216) 377-1778 to book an appointment, or leave your details here and we'll follow up by email.

fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach NUIQ Wellness Lounge & Med Spa at (216) 377-1778 or info@nuiqwellness.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.a: Our injectable menu includes wrinkle relaxers, collagen stimulators, and a range of fillers - lip, facial, and hand fillers, plus the lip flip - all aimed at a youthful, refreshed, natural-looking result. The team will recommend the right option for your goals at a consultation.
Yes - laser hair removal is one of our body services, alongside sweat reduction and stretch mark reduction. Call (216) 377-1778 or leave your details here and the team will help you plan a series.
faqs.q: Do you do laser hair removal?

faqs.a: Every plan starts with a personalized consultation. We can assess your skin with the VISIA Complexion Analysis system - it looks at wrinkles, sub-surface melanin, and vascular conditions - and build recommendations around your unique needs and goals.

Our hair restoration services combine PRF (platelet-rich fibrin) treatments, MOXI laser therapy, and Nutrafol supplements - designed to stimulate growth, improve scalp health, and strengthen hair from within.
faqs.q: What can I do about hair loss or thinning?

faqs.a: Our wellness therapies include hormone replacement therapy, lab panel testing, wellness injections, and IV vitamin infusions - personalized to help restore balance, support energy, and align with your individual goals.
faqs.q: What wellness therapies do you have?

faqs.a: Our laser and light menu includes MOXI, BBL (BroadBand Light), ClearSilk, HALO, Forever Clear, Forever Young, and Bare HR - options for pigmentation, redness, texture, and overall rejuvenation, chosen for your skin at a consultation.
faqs.q: Which laser treatments do you offer?
